description_en: This operation transfers an application or template created in CADT to another resource group
description_zh: 该接口可以将CADT创建的应用或模板从一个资源组转移到另一个资源组
kebab_example: aliyun bpstudio change-resource-group --resource-id P7RMVSVM9LOVYQOM --new-resource-group-id rg-aek2ajbjoloa23q --resource-type APPLICATION --api-version 2021-09-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CADT application or template
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource whose resource group you want to change. Valid values: APPLICATION and TEMPLATE
parameters.help_zh: 需要更换资源组的资源类型，这里指CADT应用（APPLICATION）或模板（TEMPLATE）
parameters.name: resource_type

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 执行结果码，200代表成功，其它代表失败

Data.description_en: The data returned. This parameter is not used
Data.description_zh: 该字段不返回具体业务数据

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh: 当变更失败时，返回错误信息
